changes.title: Legacy OpenAI models shut down on Oct 23, 2026
changes.summary: OpenAI is removing a batch of older models from the API on October 23, 2026, including gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4o-2024-05-13, o1, o3-mini and o4-mini. Requests to them will fail after that date. Each has a named substitute model.
changes.migration:
Replace each retiring model id string with its substitute from OpenAI's deprecations page (notice of 2026-04-22, 'Legacy GPT model snapshots'):
- gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 -> gpt-5.6-terra
- gpt-4, gpt-4-0613, gpt-4-1106-preview, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 -> gpt-5.6-sol
- gpt-4o-2024-05-13 -> gpt-5.6-sol
- gpt-4.1-nano, gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 -> gpt-5.6-luna
- o1, o1-2024-12-17, o3-mini, o3-mini-2025-01-31 -> gpt-5.6-sol
- o1-pro, o1-pro-2025-03-19 -> gpt-5.6-sol (with reasoning mode pro)
- o4-mini, o4-mini-2025-04-16 -> gpt-5.6-terra
- gpt-image-1 -> gpt-image-2.5-flare
Change only the model id strings (in code, config files or env defaults). Do not change the SDK version, request parameters or response handling. If a string type or union restricts allowed model ids, add the new id to it.

changes.title: OpenAI Node SDK v3 → v4
changes.summary: openai v4 is a rewrite: Configuration and OpenAIApi are gone, methods moved to resource namespaces, and responses are no longer wrapped in .data.
changes.migration:
1. In package.json set "openai" to "^4.104.0".
2. Replace `import { Configuration, OpenAIApi } from "openai"` with `import OpenAI from "openai"`, and `new OpenAIApi(new Configuration({ apiKey }))` with `new OpenAI({ apiKey })`.
3. `openai.createChatCompletion(params)` -> `openai.chat.completions.create(params)`; `createCompletion` -> `completions.create`; `createEmbedding` -> `embeddings.create`; `createImage` -> `images.generate`.
4. Responses are no longer wrapped: `response.data.choices` -> `response.choices`, `response.data.data` -> `response.data`.
5. Message param types: use `OpenAI.Chat.ChatCompletionMessageParam` instead of `ChatCompletionRequestMessage`.

changes.title: Adopt OpenAI's Responses API for chat calls
changes.summary: OpenAI now recommends the Responses API over Chat Completions for all new work: better results from reasoning models, lower cost through better cache use, and built-in tools and state. Chat Completions still works, so this is an upgrade you can take, not a fix you need.
changes.migration:
Move chat calls from Chat Completions to the Responses API, following OpenAI's migration guide.
1. The Responses API needs openai-node v4. If package.json has "openai" below 4.104.0, set it to "^4.104.0" and apply the v4 client changes first: `import OpenAI from "openai"`, `new OpenAI({ apiKey })` instead of `new OpenAIApi(new Configuration(...))`, and no `.data` wrapper on responses.
2. Replace `openai.chat.completions.create({ model, messages })` (or v3 `openai.createChatCompletion(...)`) with `openai.responses.create({ model, instructions, input })`.
3. Move any `{ role: "system" }` message into the top-level `instructions` string. Pass the remaining user/assistant messages as the `input` array (each item `{ role, content }` with string content); a single user message can be passed as a plain string.
4. Read the reply text from `response.output_text` instead of `choices[0].message.content`. Where code stores the assistant message for conversation history, store `{ role: "assistant", content: response.output_text }`.
5. Message types: use `OpenAI.Responses.ResponseInputItem` (or `{ role: "user" | "assistant"; content: string }`) instead of Chat Completions message types.
Keep model ids, prompts and every non-chat call (images, embeddings, audio) unchanged. Do not add tools, streaming or previous_response_id.
